decisions.reason: It is a custom earmold close to the firm's core hearing-system business and is only mentioned on the website, so little is at stake either way, but it fits the announced digital production direction and costs little to keep in a growing market.
The EARsleeve has its own page and a branded launch statement, a visible public commitment within the firm's core expertise that management would want to justify and sustain.

As equipment presented on its own page, the thermoforming unit embodies significant development and certification investment and is part of the firm's integrated dental system, so dropping it within a year would write off sunk costs.
